entities.summary: Yaroslav Volodymyrovych Yanushevych is a Ukrainian economist, civil servant, scholar, and athlete. He is an Honored Economist of Ukraine, Candidate of Economic Sciences, and Doctor of Law. He is also a world champion in paintball in the 40+ category.
